run_card.evidence_class: SAVED-BYTE CHECK + REGISTRY-MEASUREMENT + CALIBRATED-PRIVATE PROJECTION (never ORGANIZER-CONFIRMED)
run_card.hypothesis: Hidden geothermal faults are enriched 300-900 m from mapped catalogue traces (2.2-2.6x enrichment vs footprint, per-dot hit probability ~6-9% in the 300-900 m band). A budget-optimal dotted field in this band, uniform within band with minimum separation, should out-perform the catalogue-apron placement used by all nine focus sites.
run_card.mechanism: HALO lane: uniform dots in the 300-900 m (3-9 px) ring around mapped faults, min separation 3 px, binary 1.0 at dots / 0.0 elsewhere. No registry or published submission used as input. Dot count 44,090 optimized by the corrected budget law (marginal-inclusion bar h* ~1.1%; realized h ~5.1% on holdout at 44k dots; profit-maximizing count 92k-135k at constant precision).
run_card.named_non_fault_mimic: Unfaulted bedrock/alluvium contact, pluvial shoreline, saline playa margin, and any radiometric or structural feature that coincides with mapped faults but is not a fault. Controlled by using distance-to-catalogue rings (3-9 px) rather than raw geophysical thresholding, so geophysical mimics alone do not place dots.

holdout_dti.protocol: hide-and-recover: whole 8-connected fault components withheld inside label-blind eroded quadrants; visible catalogue removed in a real 3 px feature buffer; visible faults masked pixel-exactly; pooled DTI over 4 spatial quadrant folds

at_released_dot_count.ci95: fold range only (4 quadrants); full 95% spatial-block CI requires block bootstrap over resampled segments

holdout_dti.reading: Holdout-DTI ranks placement strategies on a catalogue-analogue target; it does not transfer as a private score. GEMSDOE32 scores 0.0041 on the holdout yet 0.2778 USER-REPORTED privately, proving the instrument cannot rank leaderboard-class emissions.

universal_probe_disclosed.description: r13 lattice: uniform 5-px sampling probe covering 99.87% of scored domain within 3 px
universal_probe_disclosed.note: Degenerate witness: every possible raster overlaps it. Reported separately, not counted as a duplicate witness.

reverse_overlap_disclosed.reading: Directional rule: that file is the duplicate of this one (81.33% > 70%), not vice versa. This file's worst overlap (68.49%) is below the 70% rule.

validator_output.exterior_convention: zeros (all cells finite; whole-array [0,1] — fixes the portal 'Predicted values must be in range [0, 1]' error)

score_projection.label: CALIBRATED-PRIVATE MODEL-PROJECTION — NOT A SCORE, NOT ORGANIZER-CONFIRMED
score_projection.basis: scripts/score_model.py projection; hit rate h is an ASSUMPTION, not a measurement
score_projection.reading: If the measured holdout hit rate (~5.1%) transfers to the hidden expert set, projected score ~0.48. If only holdout coverage transfers, ~0.14. Under neutral (blind) placement, ~0.26. Transfer risk is the dominant uncertainty.
